people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

translations.web: So David hid himself in the field. When the new moon had come, the king sat himself down to eat food.
translations.bsb: So David hid in the field, and when the New Moon had come, the king sat down to eat.
translations.kjv: So David hid himself in the field: and when the new moon was come, the king sat him down to eat meat.
translations.asv: So David hid himself in the field: and when the new moon was come, the king sat him down to eat food.
